title: rosa coriifolia subsp. cinerea
intro: Rosa coriifolia subsp. cinerea, commonly known as the Grey Climbing Rose, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Rosa coriifolia subsp. cinerea are attributed to its flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which have been traditionally used to treat various ailments such as anxiety, insomnia, and skin conditions. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids like quercetin and kaempferol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects on human health.
